rubric.criterion: The tested normalization and API payload behavior remain correct.
A Zod schema is the runtime validation source and the form value type is derived from it rather than repeated.

A focused form hook under the hooks directory owns TanStack Form setup, validation, normalization, and submission orchestration. Hook subdirectories appear only when project size makes a flat hooks directory difficult to navigate.
The form component receives typed initial values, onSubmit, and onCancel callbacks through a named interface without deciding navigation or mutation side effects.
The form uses one shared layout and action arrangement rather than recreating field spacing and buttons locally.
The implementation introduces no any, broad object type, unchecked cast, non-null assertion, or long-lived unknown value.
Derived defaults and prop changes are handled through initialization, controlled state, keys, or event logic rather than synchronization Effects.
